description: Information about an event declaring that certain objects have been associated or disassociated with one or more Track and Trace (TT) trade transactions.

actionCode.description: The code specifying the action for this TT transaction event.

businessRelatedLocation.description: The business location related to this TT transaction event.

businessStepCode.description: The code specifying the business step for this TT transaction event.

destinationRelatedParty.description: A destination related party for this TT transaction event.

dispositionCode.description: The code specifying the disposition related to this TT transaction event.

identifier.description: The identifier for this TT transaction event.

objectInstanceId.description: An instance identifier for an object of this TT transaction event.

occurrenceDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value at which this TT transaction event occurred.

parentObjectId.description: The identifier of the parent object for this TT transaction event.

quantitySpecifiedEventElement.description: A quantity event element specified for this TT transaction event.

readPointRelatedLocation.description: The read point related location of this TT transaction event.

recordedDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value at which this TT transaction event was recorded.

relatedCertification.description: A certification related to this TT transaction event.

sourceRelatedParty.description: A source related party for this TT transaction event.

specifiedError.description: A declared error specified for this TT transaction event.

specifiedTradeTransaction.description: A trade transaction specified for this TT transaction event.
